bookingNotes.title: Nail trim or full groom
bookingNotes.text: R6 lists both nail trims and full-service grooms. For nail care alone, ask whether a separate appointment is needed. For a full groom, request an itemized quote so you know which coat, nail and finishing work is included.

bookingNotes.title: Breed style and farm-dog coats
bookingNotes.text: The business specifically welcomes breed-specific grooms and large farm dogs. Share your dog’s size, coat condition and preferred finish when enquiring. Mention mud, burrs or tangles in advance and ask how extra coat work affects the appointment length and price.

bookingNotes.title: Booking for a cat
bookingNotes.text: Cat grooming is confirmed in the business’s update. Describe whether your cat needs coat maintenance, a trim or help with tangles, and ask which of those services R6 offers for cats. Confirm handling arrangements and any preparation instructions before bringing your cat.
